title: Shield AI software lets Taiwan drone boats shadow intruder
source_used: Army Recognition (full text of a related article of 14 Oct 2026); Defence Blog page blocked (403); Shield AI and Naval News pages did not cover the trial
key_facts: In July 2026, Thunder Tiger SeaShark 600 and SeaShark 800 unmanned surface vessels equipped with Shield AI's Hivemind autonomy software ran a coordinated maritime surveillance demonstration in Taiwan.
The boats used radar, imagery and ship-tracking (Automatic Identification System) data.
Hivemind autonomously planned waypoints, divided search tasks, identified a vessel of interest and coordinated the boats during an escort mission.
The trial did not demonstrate autonomous weapon use; Shield AI is not part of the weapons package Thunder Tiger showed in Washington.
Thunder Tiger is a Taiwanese maker; the SeaShark 600 is a six-meter aluminum boat, up to 50 knots, range over 350 kilometers.

Shield AI announced on 15 Oct 2026 (company site) a post titled "Six Weeks to Sea: Hivemind Brings Thunder Tiger's SeaSharks Together"; Defence Blog headlined on 16 Oct 2026 "Shield AI software lets Taiwan drone boats shadow intruder". Neither page could be read.
quote_evidence: In July 2026, SeaShark 600 and SeaShark 800 USVs equipped with Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy software conducted a coordinated maritime ISR demonstration in Taiwan using radar, imagery and Automatic Identification System data.
Hivemind autonomously planned waypoints, divided search tasks, identified a vessel of interest and coordinated the USVs during an escort mission.
The trial did not demonstrate autonomous weapon employment, and Shield AI has not been identified as part of the Bullfrog-Switchblade weapon integration displayed in Washington.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows boats from different makers being coordinated by one autonomy system for surveillance and escort, though it was a demonstration with no weapons use.
event_date: July 2026 (trial); Shield AI write-up 15 Oct 2026; Defence Blog 16 Oct 2026
notes: The Defence Blog page (the pool item) is blocked (403) and was not read. Its headline matches the July 2026 SeaShark trial described by Army Recognition (14 Oct 2026), and Shield AI posted about it on 15 Oct 2026, so the entry is built on Army Recognition; if the Defence Blog describes a newer trial this entry should be redone.
